source_text: In sub-Saharan Africa, voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs have continued to expand as a public health strategy for HIV prevention, with a 2023 World Health Organization assessment confirming the procedure's cost-effectiveness and its capacity to reduce heterosexual HIV acquisition risk by up to 60%, prompting calls for sustained scale-up amid funding challenges. [103]
